title: valeriana battandieri
intro: Valeriana battandieri, commonly known as the Atlas valerian, is a plant species in the Valerianaceae family, native to the Atlas Mountains in North Africa. The Atlas valerian is valued for its medicinal properties, providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness due to its health benefits, including sedative and anti-anxiety effects. The therapeutic actions of Valeriana battandieri include acting as a nervous system depressant, which helps in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include valerenic acid, isovaleric acid, and valepotriates, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
